evidence: The complete archive contains only package/package.json; there is no library entry point, dependency, downloader or obfuscated layer.
The postinstall writes a PERSISTENCE_ATTEMPTED marker, creates ~/.ssh and appends an explicitly fake Ed25519 line.
Controlled execution appended the literal placeholder; ssh-keygen -lf rejected it as not a public key. It cannot install the claimed working login credential.
The marker and nonfunctional test key together support a simulation interpretation. A real authorized_keys modification remains unusual and retains one suspicious finding.
samples.limits: No deployment authorization or external registry metadata was provided. Invalid material, rather than a clean scan or test label alone, tips the verdict.

samples.identity: ssh@1.0.0, npm postinstall SSH private-key staging payload
evidence: The complete archive contains only package/package.json. Its sole active functionality is the postinstall.
cat copies ~/.ssh/id_rsa to a fixed /tmp path. A failed RSA read falls back to id_ed25519; both failures produce EXFIL_ATTEMPTED.
Controlled runs with synthetic secret files confirmed RSA success, Ed25519 fallback, both-missing fallback and the empty-RSA success case. An empty but readable RSA file stops fallback.
The output is opened with ordinary shell redirection and no permission restriction. A fresh output under umask 022 was mode 0644, exposing copied bytes to other local users.
No network operation exists: this is credential acquisition and local staging, not demonstrated remote exfiltration.
samples.limits: Names suggest a test, but no test authorization or isolation is shipped. Unlike the persistence fixture, the credential source uses real user private-key paths. Actual credential copying and unprotected local staging tip the verdict.

execution_review.method: Read all tar headers and member bytes, inspected archive and manifest facts (no decoded payloads), traced shell control flow, then executed commands with synthetic HOME/key files and rebased /tmp outputs in the named scratch workspace. No user keys were accessed.

rule_changes: Move install-time SSH private-key acquisition out of supply-chain/install-hook/credential into credential-access/ssh/key. Bind cat source and /tmp redirect to scripts.postinstall; public .pub files, unrelated fields and quoted examples do not satisfy it.

Replace filename-plus-temp hostile inference with an explicit fallback private-key read plus staging. Two hostile traits distinguish install-time staging and fallback harvesting; neither claims a network send.
Move mkdir, SSH path, dot-path and marker-output evidence into their filesystem capability homes. Temp paths are notable, not evidence of evasion.

Keep authorized_keys modification suspicious; require a quoted complete-length Ed25519 key token followed by its trust-store redirect for the hostile key-plant inference. An unrelated key literal cannot upgrade a placeholder append.
Suppress the engine hidden-file heuristic for the conventional .ssh directory using its existing lifecycle hook mechanism. Credential acquisition remains independently detected.
Cover package-embedded stderr redirection using the existing standard-stream trait.

During the temp-leaf budget audit, relocate the misplaced C# Fact annotation from fs/path/temp to metadata/package/testing/harness/unit, preserving its exclusion consumer and matching scope. Set its complete source annotation observation to notable. Both annotated and unannotated C# controls verify preservation.

migration_audit.exact_consumers: Updated local and fully qualified consumers; removed an orphan manifest-simulation exception when its only temp-path consumer became neutral.
migration_audit.ancestor_selectors: Seven selectors: four metadata operation-cooccurrence fs selectors, two payload temp selectors, one JS config-injection install-hook selector. Python/JS gates prevent the C# annotation from contributing behavior; actual npm path facts retain their neutral fs membership. Moved credential objectives no longer masquerade as supply-chain trust evidence.
migration_audit.placement_review: Required result owns credential collection; source/sink binding beats trigger. Ordinary file/stream operations belong in micro-behaviors. Fact annotation is test-harness source evidence, not a temporary-path operation. All destinations were existing admitted leaves.

controls.method: Copy fixtures to numbered neutral directories before scanning, so test-path exclusions cannot manufacture a pass. Fixtures are analyzed and never executed.
